description: This Java class, StoreLandingController, is a Spring MVC controller responsible for managing the store landing page within the admin interface of the application. It provides methods for displaying the store landing page, retrieving and initializing content descriptions for different languages, and saving updates to the store landing page content.

classes.name: StoreLandingController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing store landing page content in the admin interface, including displaying and saving landing page information.

methods.name: displayStoreLanding
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the store landing page, loading content descriptions for each language and preparing the model for view rendering.

methods.name: saveStoreLanding
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save updates to the store landing page content, including creation or updating Content and ContentDescription entities.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set up the menu context in the model for navigation purposes.
